| nil => exact h1 x_1
| cons a as ih => exact h2 a as x_1 (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: x_1))

induction x generalizing x_1 with
| nil => rw [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact h1 x_1
| cons a as ih => rw [List.flatMapM.loop]; exact h2 a as x_1 (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: x_1))

induction x generalizing x_1 with
| nil => unfold List.flatMapM.loop; exact h1 x_1
| cons a as ih => unfold List.flatMapM.loop; exact h2 a as x_1 (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: x_1))
